cache.disk.directory.description: Filesystem path where tile cache is stored on disk.

cache.disk.cleanup.enabled.description: Enable background cleanup of expired tiles.

cache.db.path.description: Path to SQLite database file (if using SQLite cache).

cache.db.table.description: SQLite table name for tile storage.

tilesets.description: List of tilesets (layers) to cache, each referencing a source and defining cache behavior.

sources.description: Upstream data sources used by tilesets.

services.wmts.enabled.description: Enable WMTS (Web Map Tile Service) endpoint.

errors.report.description: Whether to return detailed error messages in responses (set to false for security in production).

defaults.expires.description: Global default tile cache expiry (seconds), used if tileset doesn't specify.

defaults.tile_cache.description: Name of the default tile cache to use if not set per tileset.
